concepts.gloss_en: The covenant of salt (Num 18:19), an epithet for the tzaddik; distinct from the plain 'eternal covenant' (ברית עולם) which lacks the salt motif

members.note: same 'covenant of salt' motif equated with the tzaddik; עולם is a modifier of the same biblical phrase, not a different head

concepts.gloss_en: The eternal covenant, tied to prayer / the 18 blessings and 'tzaddik chai almin'; no salt element — a different construct phrase

members.note: distinct construct: 'eternal covenant', aspect of prayer, not the covenant of salt

notes: Cluster grouped by token-overlap on ברית. 'ברית מלח עולם' and 'ברית מלח' share the salt-covenant referent (both = the tzaddik) and are merged; 'ברית עולם' drops מלח entirely and denotes a different biblical phrase used for a different idea (prayer / chai almin), so kept separate.
